adversarial.text: 'Democratic Republic of Congo' (without 'the'), 'Dem Rep Congo' and 'Republic of Congo' are all unrecognized. Dropping 'the' is 4 edits away, beyond tolerance. DR Congo (~100M+) is one of only four answers to this question, and 'Democratic Republic of Congo' is probably the most common way to write it.
adversarial.suggestion: Add to COD: "Democratic Republic of Congo", "Dem Rep Congo", "DR of Congo", "Congo DR". Add to COG: "Republic of Congo". Alternatively, have normalize() drop the word 'the' everywhere, not just at the start.

adversarial.text: Bare 'Congo' is an alias of the Republic of the Congo (~6M), but many players say 'Congo' meaning DR Congo. On this question a player meaning the DRC gets matched to the RoC and busts.
adversarial.suggestion: Remove "Congo" from COG's aliases and make it an extra that tells the player 'Which Congo? Type DR Congo or Republic of the Congo', ideally without consuming the guess. At minimum, show the matched full name before scoring.

adversarial.text: 'Nigera', a very common misspelling of Nigeria (the top answer here), is exactly 1 edit from both Nigeria and Niger. The tie returns unrecognized, so the player scores 0 despite the promised typo forgiveness. The same tie mechanism kills 'Brundi' (Burundi vs Brunei, matters for d3q2), 'Uwanda' (Rwanda vs Uganda) and 'Nambia' (Namibia vs Gambia/Zambia).
adversarial.suggestion: Add aliases "Nigera" (NGA), "Brundi" (BDI), "Nambia" (NAM). Better: break fuzzy ties by preferring the candidate with the same first letters/length, or the longer name when the input is longer than the shorter candidate.

adversarial.text: Small African places that players may type are unrecognized: Reunion, Mayotte, Zanzibar, Saint Helena, Canary Islands, Ceuta, Melilla, Somaliland. Western Sahara is recognized but shows the misleading 'not covered by World Bank data' reason (see d1q1).
adversarial.suggestion: Add extras: Reunion/Mayotte ("an overseas department of France"), Zanzibar ("part of Tanzania"), Saint Helena ("a British Overseas Territory"), Canary Islands/Ceuta/Melilla ("part of Spain"), Somaliland ("not a UN member state; internationally part of Somalia").

adversarial.text: Eritrea (~$2B) and South Sudan (~$5B) are among the most obvious 'small African economy' answers, but both are noData. They get 0 with 'has no figure for this in the source data', which a player who answered correctly will feel cheated by. The same pair is noData in d3q5.
adversarial.suggestion: Fill Eritrea/South Sudan GDP from IMF WEO or UN estimates, or make noData answers a free retry, or print 'No data: Eritrea, South Sudan' under the prompt.

adversarial.text: 'Burkina' (common shorthand for Burkina Faso, which sits near this $20B line) is unrecognized.
adversarial.suggestion: Add alias "Burkina" to BFA. Also consider "Guinea-Conakry"/"Guinea Conakry" for GIN.
